reports.text:
This week felt mostly too hard for me. I played all seven days, but I only got 37 right out of 95 cards. Multiple choice and typed meaning were shaky, and say translation was worst: just 1 right out of 8, and 4 of my spoken answers were never heard, which was frustrating. Typed translation and letter tiles gave me nothing.

The good part is that no word was repeated within a session, so it never felt like the same card again and again. Words like please, never and only did come back after 4 days, and need and too after 3.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked: love, mean, said, give, much, sure, thing, help, anything, still, find. They never came back, so I could not fix them. I saved 32 new words, but those lost ones worry me.

This week felt a bit too hard for me. I showed up every day and saved 52 new words, but I got only 56 of 120 cards right. Matching was the worst: 16 of 40. Say translation was rough too, just 3 of 10. Typed meaning went better, 27 of 50, so that's where I feel most comfortable.

Nothing felt repetitive. No word came back twice in the same session, so I never got a second try right away to fix a mistake. Some words did return on a later day, like because, sorry, little and nothing, which helped.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that never came back: say, love, mean, give, help, find, still, and more. Those are basic words, and no card asked me about them all week. I'd like them to show up soon.

Six spoken answers weren't heard, and two cards didn't match any saved word. That was annoying.
